text.title: 窗边的一段文字
text.situation:
窗边的书桌上，乔根据采访起草文章。第一段先写调整后的开放时间，再讲维修。每项仍举行的活动都有一个项目符号条目。她从头到尾读了内容：细节齐全，却还不连贯。一句话让读者去旧入口，下一句又引导他们去侧门。诺拉把最新地图放在初稿旁。乔改正路线，删去一句重复日期的话。窗外传来楼下拖动椅子的声音，文章里的人已经在准备晚间课程了。

乔：日期准确，但路线让人困惑。
诺拉：假设你从未到过这里，再读那段话。
乔：我先写侧门，用项目符号列活动。

paragraphs.en: At the window desk, Jo was drafting an article from the interview. The first paragraph put the changed opening times before the story of the repairs. She added a bullet point for each activity that was still running, then read the content from beginning to end. The details were all there, but the article was not yet coherent: one sentence sent readers to the old entrance, while the next directed them to the side gate. Nora placed the latest map beside the draft. Jo corrected the route and removed a sentence that repeated the date. Through the open window came the sound of someone dragging a chair downstairs. The people in the article were already getting ready for the evening class.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: The dates are accurate, but the route is confusing.
Nora: Read that paragraph as if you had never visited.
Jo: I will put the side gate first and use bullet points for the activities.
